recipes.name: Vegan Mac & 'Cheese'
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (200°C)*. Add the cashews to a bowl and cover with plenty of boiling water. Set aside.

Add 1 inch (2 cm) of water to a large pot and bring to a simmer. Place the potatoes, carrots, onion, and garlic in a steamer basket, cover, and steam for 10 to 15 minutes until tender**. Then drain and add to a blender.
Add the drained cashews and all of the remaining 'cheese' sauce ingredients to the blender. Blend until smooth. Set aside.
Cook the pasta in a large pot of salted boiling water following the package instructions. Add the broccoli florets during the last 3 minutes of cooking. Drain once the pasta is al dente.
Meanwhile, mix the bread crumbs, melted butter, and smoked paprika powder in a small bowl.
Add the drained pasta, broccoli, and sauce to a large baking dish. Toss together.
Top with the bread crumbs and bake for 20 minutes, until the top is golden and crispy.

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milk that is fortified with calcium . * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection). ** If you don't have a steamer basket, simply cook in the simmering water.
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to three days.
